_comment: Manually curated corrections for MusicBrainz disambiguation errors. Each key is an artist name as it appears in Marcus's listening. Each value either has a 'mbid' (force this MBID) or 'tags' (skip MB entirely).

Death.note: Detroit proto-punk band (Dragster/Keep On Knocking). The MB search returns the death-metal band; this is the punk band Marcus actually listens to.

Voluptuous Horror of Karen Black.note: Karen Black's no-wave band. No MB entry; not on MusicBrainz.

Ton Steine Scherben.note: MB only has 5 weak tags (krautrock, proto-punk, rock). TSS is actually Deutsch-Punk / Polit-Punk, very specifically West Berlin 1975-1985.

Flamin' Groovies.note: MB tags are correct. Power pop is the right primary label.

R.L. Burnside.note: MB tags exist but are spread across blues sub-genres.

Carsick Cars.note: Beijing post-punk band. MB has minimal Chinese indie tags.

Fehlfarben.note: NDW band. MB has it tagged as 'neue deutsche welle' actually. Verify.

The Slits.note: British post-punk / feminist punk. MB has 'post-punk' as main tag.

Wolf Maahn.note: Deutschrock. MB tags may be too generic.

Häppchen.note: German punk band. Not well-known enough for rich MB tags.
